links.comparator_used: Same stacking model without reweighing bias mitigation (pre-mitigation baseline)
links.outcome: Model fairness across racial and gender groups, and predictive performance
links.effect: Reweighing improved fairness across racial and gender groups without compromising performance (no numeric fairness metrics given in the abstract)
links.quote: The reweighing preprocessing technique applied to the stacking algorithm effectively improved the model's fairness across racial and gender groups without compromising performance.

links.comparator_used: Previous model built on EHR and wearable data only, without genomic data
links.outcome: Area under the curve for predicting chronic opioid use
links.quote: The genetic data enhanced model performance from the prior model, with the area under the curve improving from 0.90 (95% CI, 0.88-0.92) to 0.95 (95% CI, 0.89-0.95).
